feature_availability.point_in_time_definition: certified means every source-backed feature is available by the snapshot; a documented contract prior or explicit unknown value is allowed only when its missingness/sample-weight representation is part of the feature contract

source_scope: numeric Fonbet IDs; singles; each feature and label gated by its source availability time

training_gate.unknown_result_time_policy: keep_confirmed_labels_in_evaluation_windows; purge from each training fold unless source availability precedes that fold
